baseline_definitions.A_uniform_over_output_slots: uniform over the model's real output space (core_idx_tensor, 17 slots); the model is not constrained to point inside the peptide, so this is chance for what it actually emits
baseline_definitions.B_uniform_over_anchor_windows: uniform over the anchor's own 9-mer windows; chance GIVEN that the peptide's location is already known -- it credits locating the peptide and asks only about register

note: Enumerated per case, not 1/n: same_core compares the 9-mer STRING, so a repeated 9-mer inside one peptide counts as a match at two indices.
